issues.explanation: Fake provider capture does not produce real global canon; chapter extraction was tested with CANONICAL_ENTITY_MAP: [].
issues.recommended_fix: Run global normalization through real/manual ChatGPT response and re-run chapter prompt capture with populated map, or add first-pass local candidate mode.

issues.explanation: Persistent artifacts like ベル have no first-class home in chapter extraction output.
issues.recommended_fix: Add objects array to chapter extraction schema and downstream mapper.

issues.explanation: Global prompt wording implies entire novel while selective expansion may only send batch evidence.
issues.recommended_fix: Reword as incremental/global normalization over batch evidence.

issues.explanation: Narrative relations like protector, guardian, rescuer, usurper, survivor_of and keeper_of artifact are forced into broad relation types.
issues.recommended_fix: Expand relation taxonomy or allow subtype/details.

issues.explanation: Dense prologue has more than three durable events and event prioritization may compress useful structure.
issues.recommended_fix: Allow higher event cap or event priority tiers.

issues.explanation: If canonical map is empty/incomplete, prompt should extract strong local candidates without pretending they are canonical.
Important artifacts should not be represented as concepts only.
